entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: One of the three Eldrazi titans, a reality-slicing titan of distortion who changes perception, twists loyalties and induces despair.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: One of the three Eldrazi titans; Kozilek stands between him and Emrakul in size.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: One of the three Eldrazi titans, the largest.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titanic beings imprisoned on Zendikar by Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin Markov, including the titans and their spawn and broods.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: Zendikari merfolk god inspired by Kozilek.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who with Nahiri and Sorin trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar, inscribing the hedrons with draconic runes and unleashing ghostfire.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker whose home plane is Zendikar; she built the hedron network and warned the inhabitants of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped trap the Eldrazi, draining their strength.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, where the Eldrazi were trapped and later released.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Stones pulled from Zendikar's living rock and inscribed with runes, forming a lure and trap for the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The heart of the trap, where the three planeswalkers combined their magic and locked the chamber.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who released the titans Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who reignited his spark by draining the hedron network that imprisoned Ulamog.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A newly formed group of planeswalkers that rallied Zendikar's defenses and bound Ulamog and Kozilek.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The war against the released Eldrazi, ending in the Gatewatch's last stand.

events.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a trap network of leylines, hedrons and mana nodes on Zendikar, with Nahiri building it and Ugin inscribing runes.
events.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

events.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's inhabitants as the Eldrazi approach in -1400 AR, and the three titans descend upon Zendikar.
events.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek, and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

events.summary: The three planeswalkers fight, converge at the Eye of Ugin and activate the hedron network, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
events.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

events.summary: Nissa Revane releases the titans, and Kozilek's brood is said to retreat to remote corners of the world.
events.quote: After the release of the titans Emrakul , Ulamog , and Kozilek by Nissa Revane

events.summary: Kozilek emerges from deep underground after Ob Nixilis drains the hedron network imprisoning Ulamog.
events.quote: Kozilek emerged from deep underground nearby.

events.summary: The Gatewatch binds Ulamog and Kozilek in a web of leylines and burns them, ending Kozilek's material manifestation on Zendikar.
events.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Kozilek on Zendikar.

relations.note: One of the three Eldrazi titans.
relations.quote: is one of the three Eldrazi titans

relations.note: Worked together with Sorin to trap the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Ugin , Nahiri , and Sorin Markov prepared thoroughly to trap them

relations.note: The Gatewatch attacked and bound Kozilek.
relations.quote: The Gatewatch members performed an orchestrated attack on Ulamog and Kozilek

relations.note: Nissa released Kozilek from his prison.
relations.quote: After the release of the titans Emrakul , Ulamog , and Kozilek by Nissa Revane
